title: Arithmetic restriction and its specified product and cocone maps
statement: For an abelian category $A$ [def-sp-abelian], let $q_e(n)=e(n+1)-1$ on $\mathbb N^{\mathrm{op}}$ and define $r_e(T)=T\circ q_e$ and its termwise complex functor and exact derived functor [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. For a tower $X$ of complexes, define $a_e$ from $\prod_n X_n$ to $\prod_n X_{q_e(n)}$ by projection onto $q_e(n)$, and define the $n$-th coordinate of $b_e$ to be $\sum_{k=0}^{e-1}\operatorname{pr}_{q_e(n)+k}X(q_e(n)+k\to q_e(n))$ [def-weil-category-product]. Let $L$ be termwise inverse limit, and let $\alpha_e:LX\to Lr_eX$ be the canonical restriction of limit cones in each degree. Let $\delta_X=1-s$ be the product transition endomorphism of the evaluated tower and let $M(X)$ be its actual mapping cocone. These are precisely the existing definitions moved from lem-sp-strict-tower-arithmetic-restriction, with unchanged data and public names.
